text: Wahoo Fitness founder Chip Hawkins, alongside three equal strategic investment partners (Rhone Group, David Wichmann of Jory Capital & Human Powered Health, and RZC Investments), bought back the business in 2023 after the banks had taken it over.
short: Wahoo was bought back by founder Chip Hawkins and three investment partners in 2023.

source.name: DC Rainmaker: Wahoo Fitness Founder Buys Company Back from Banks
source.quote: Chip himself, alongside three “equal strategic partners”, have bought back the business.
source.note: The article also lists the three partners: Rhone Group, 'David Wichmann of Jory Capital & Human Powered Health', and RZC Investments.
